title: Pointer to the properties of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]
text:
In the notation of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange], the following holds. On
$\Dplus(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ this exchange morphism is the exchange
morphism of [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange], by
[lem-kun-unbounded-exchange-agrees]; the bounded case is
lem:weil-pbc-derived-exchange-replacement.
